headline: Why the model likes Charlotte
caption:
The road team is the pick tonight. Here's why.

An average game starts with the home team by 2.3, so Brooklyn begins with the edge. The biggest bar flips it: Charlotte's recent point differential moved our model 7.0 points toward the Hornets. Team efficiency nudges 0.3 back toward the Nets, and tonight's players add 0.3 for Charlotte.

The result: Charlotte Hornets at 66% to win in Brooklyn.

Do you buy the Hornets on the road tonight?
